scope: source-grounded blind human fidelity review packet construction

selection.ordering: SHA-256 rank from frozen seed, rule hash, and sample hash
selection.sample_count: positive bounded prefix of the deterministic ranking
selection.duplicate_policy: reject duplicate sample IDs, sample hashes, or source/transformed text pairs

replay.private_manifest: binds selected source pairs, orientations, display order, seed, and packet hash
replay.verification: rebuild packet from the exact source pool and reject any mismatch
replay.judgment_binding: opaque item labels are bound to source-grounded review samples only after packet verification

release_status: does not promote any transformation and does not constitute human fidelity evidence
